info.description: Your personal life manager, built with privacy, choice and beauty at its heart.

servers.description: Athena API — resolved relative to the host serving this document

post.summary: Send a message in an AI chat conversation with streaming support
post.description: Streams an AI chat response to the client using Server-Sent Events (SSE). Each event contains an OpenAI-compatible incremental content delta. A 'thinking' field is present during the model's reasoning phase; the client accumulates it separately and clears its loading state only when the first actual content word arrives.

model.description: The AI model identifier to use for the response.

messages.description: The full conversation message history to send to the model.

persona.description: Optional persona name to apply to the AI.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Higher values produce more varied output.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

conversationId.description: ID of an existing conversation to continue. Omit to start a new conversation.

stream.description: Whether to stream the response via Server-Sent Events.

includeData.description: Optional contextual data to include with the request, such as specific user profile fields.

delete.summary: Delete a message from a specific conversation
delete.description: Removes a message by its ID from the specified conversation, provided the authenticated user owns it.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: The ID of the conversation containing the message.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The ID of the message to delete.

type.description: Account type. Must be a valid AccountType enum value.

status.description: Account status. Must be a valid AccountStatus enum value. Defaults to active.

institution.description: Name of the financial institution holding this account.

accountNumber.description: Account number or identifier as shown on statements.

balance.description: Opening balance of the account. For asset accounts a positive value is a deposit; for liabilities a positive value represents outstanding debt.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the account.

lastSynced.description: Date the account was last synchronised with an external source.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to store alongside the account.

relatedAssetId.description: ID of an asset secured by this liability account (liability accounts only).

originalBalance.description: Principal balance at origination, used to reconstruct historical liability transactions (liability accounts only).

creditLimit.description: Maximum credit limit of the account (liability accounts only).

interestRate.description: Annual interest rate as a decimal (liability accounts only).

rateType.description: Whether the interest rate is fixed or variable. Must be a valid AccountRateType enum value (liability accounts only).

termDays.description: Total term of the loan in days (liability accounts only).

repaymentAmount.description: Scheduled repayment amount per period (liability accounts only).

repaymentPeriodDays.description: Number of days between scheduled repayments (liability accounts only).

repaymentNextDueDate.description: Date the next repayment is due (liability accounts only).

originationDate.description: Date the loan or credit facility was originally issued (liability accounts only). Required alongside originalBalance to trigger the two-transaction origination flow.

get.summary: Retrieve exchange rates for a currency pair
get.description: Returns historical exchange rates for a given currency pair over a resolved date range. Non-USD pairs are computed automatically via triangular arbitrage using USD as the base currency.

parameters.name: fromCode
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code to convert from. Must be a supported currency.

parameters.name: toCode
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code to convert to. Must be a supported currency.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Predefined time period for the date range. Must match a value from the TimePeriod enum.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Data grouping interval for the returned rates. Must match a value from the TimeInterval enum.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional explicit start date for the range (ISO 8601 date). Overrides the period-resolved start when provided.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Optional explicit end date for the range (ISO 8601 date). Overrides the period-resolved end when provided.

data.description: Array of exchange rate data points

date.description: Date of the exchange rate entry (ISO 8601)

rate.description: Exchange rate from the source to target currency

source.description: Data provider that supplied this rate

meta.description: Contextual metadata describing the resolved query parameters

period.description: Time period used to resolve the range

start.description: Resolved start of the date range (ISO 8601)

end.description: Resolved end of the date range (ISO 8601)
